recommendation_summary: The reply recommends skipping the central log and Docker and setting up an externally hosted dead man's switch, such as a Healthchecks.io check, that `nightly-sync` pings only after it succeeds, so the user is alerted if no ping arrives by about 04:00.
note: The reply recommends a single external heartbeat alert and rejects the log and Docker setup, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
